acceptance.adversarial: Stall the model, saturate its queue, inject an attention-module result into a trading consumer and set apply_effect=true on wrong-scope evidence; no risk/stop/reconcile wait or unauthorized effect is permitted.
acceptance.positive: Run admitted typed Jev judgments and model research through the actual durable asynchronous path; qualified snapshots improve a later eligible decision while urgent execution/protection continues.
acceptance.recovery: Restart the isolated worker, replay the original work IDs within bounded backlog and expire obsolete responses; preserve open-parent protection and the baseline.

requirements.text: Shared Jev consumer scope and asynchronous isolation: Run admitted typed Jev judgments and model research through the actual durable asynchronous path; qualified snapshots improve a later eligible decision while urgent execution/protection continues.
requirements.title: Shared Jev consumer scope and asynchronous isolation

acceptance.adversarial: Silently redirect an alias, change prompt/retrieval/calibration or supply a wrong-context response; prior qualification cannot authorize the changed identity.
acceptance.positive: Bind requested and resolved model, prompt/data/tool/config versions and response receipts to one qualification epoch; replay the recorded response and reproduce downstream decisions without invoking a provider.
acceptance.recovery: Quarantine unknown identity, retain old decisions, requalify the new epoch and atomically activate a compatible binding with authoritative readback.

requirements.text: Exact model epoch, output provenance and replay: Bind requested and resolved model, prompt/data/tool/config versions and response receipts to one qualification epoch; replay the recorded response and reproduce downstream decisions without invoking a provider.
requirements.title: Exact model epoch, output provenance and replay

acceptance.adversarial: Inject future/model-memorized outcomes, copied-source corroboration, prompt instructions in filings, cross-account memory and secret-bearing fields; block leakage or mark historical results nonconfirmatory, never execute embedded instructions.
acceptance.positive: Build a scoped evidence packet from archived sources available at the cutoff; confirm findings prospectively with sealed outputs and explicit model-weight contamination limitations.
acceptance.recovery: Revoke tainted artifacts, invalidate affected studies, restore admissible source/index versions and confirm on fresh protected prospective observations.

requirements.text: Point-in-time information, privacy and contamination controls: Build a scoped evidence packet from archived sources available at the cutoff; confirm findings prospectively with sealed outputs and explicit model-weight contamination limitations.
requirements.title: Point-in-time information, privacy and contamination controls

acceptance.adversarial: Submit only 50 correlated disagreements, missing calibration, positive gross means with negative net costs, or a change-helped score labeled trade-win probability; probability-dependent/economic admission fails.
acceptance.positive: Measure a declared target across the eligible opportunity population, against its base-rate comparator; qualify a controlled positive net contribution using registered dependence, selection, uncertainty and cost procedures.
acceptance.recovery: Restore full trials and missingness accounting, recompute target-specific calibration and confidence on new protected data; retain explanation-only use only where independently qualified.

requirements.text: Target-correct calibration and complete economic qualification: Measure a declared target across the eligible opportunity population, against its base-rate comparator; qualify a controlled positive net contribution using registered dependence, selection, uncertainty and cost procedures.
requirements.title: Target-correct calibration and complete economic qualification

acceptance.adversarial: Race workers, exhaust budget with malformed/failed outputs, trigger fallback retries or cancel after provider acceptance; no unreserved call or reset of costs is allowed and unknown bills retain liability.
acceptance.positive: Atomically reserve bounded per-attempt monetary/token/tool allowance across workers, settle actual costs and reconcile provider quotas with the global ledger.
acceptance.recovery: Crash before/after reservation and settlement, recover the same attempt IDs and reconcile unknown charges without double billing or duplicate provider work; use qualified no-model fallback.

requirements.text: Durable global model and research budgets: Atomically reserve bounded per-attempt monetary/token/tool allowance across workers, settle actual costs and reconcile provider quotas with the global ledger.
requirements.title: Durable global model and research budgets

acceptance.adversarial: Leak author/model identity through nested fields or free text, reuse the holdout, let the proposer accept its own result or count correlated model agreement as independent proof; fail review/qualification.
acceptance.positive: Compare numerical baseline, baseline plus Jev, and separate Argon/DeepSeek challenger arms on preregistered tasks with equal information and independent outcomes; preserve full trial and reviewer provenance.
acceptance.recovery: Replace tainted review packets, retain rejected trials and failed canaries, re-establish separate review/holdout access and repeat evaluation with a fresh protected window.

requirements.text: Independent review and measured Jev/model contribution: Compare numerical baseline, baseline plus Jev, and separate Argon/DeepSeek challenger arms on preregistered tasks with equal information and independent outcomes; preserve full trial and reviewer provenance.
requirements.title: Independent review and measured Jev/model contribution

acceptance.adversarial: Promote a leaderboard score, increased leverage, fill-only gains or an expensive model with negative incremental net utility; reject unsupported benefit and prevent expanding tools or risk to manufacture a win.
acceptance.positive: Execute the registered execution-drag, selection, reasoning, event, capital-efficiency and research-economics experiments with controlled positive/null oracles and cost/risk-matched account paths.
acceptance.recovery: Retain the simpler qualified baseline, revise only within the registered research budget and evaluate a frozen new hypothesis on fresh evidence; inconclusive remains a valid result.

requirements.text: Prioritized net-profitability experiments and value-of-information routing: Execute the registered execution-drag, selection, reasoning, event, capital-efficiency and research-economics experiments with controlled positive/null oracles and cost/risk-matched account paths.
requirements.title: Prioritized net-profitability experiments and value-of-information routing

acceptance.adversarial: Mark a consistently losing policy healthy solely because it obeys rules, rewrite policy after one ordinary loss, hide stale model identity/costs or reactivate a revoked fallback; appropriate gates fail.
acceptance.positive: Expose policy/procedural, economic, data, calibration and provider health separately; registered drift/hysteresis rules change a later qualified choice with evidence and exact consumer readback.
acceptance.recovery: Keep urgent protection during suspension, reconcile open parents and corrected labels, and resume only a currently qualified compatible binding with durable owner-visible status.

requirements.text: Separate health dimensions, bounded adaptation and owner readback: Expose policy/procedural, economic, data, calibration and provider health separately; registered drift/hysteresis rules change a later qualified choice with evidence and exact consumer readback.
requirements.title: Separate health dimensions, bounded adaptation and owner readback
